summary_1line: Bhima and Karna wage a ferocious duel; Bhima slays several of Duryodhana’s brothers including Vikarna, fulfilling his vow and shaking the Kaurava army.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima, standing on his chariot, releases seven blazing arrows that strike down seven Kaurava princes at once.
Bhima pauses in grief beside the fallen Vikarna, lamenting even as the battlefield roars around him.
The battlefield becomes a river of blood strewn with shattered chariots, elephants, golden ornaments, and arrows as Karna and Bhima continue their duel.
